content: Static export (output:export) unsupported: pages-router API routes, route handlers that rely on Request or use non-GET verbs, rewrites/redirects/headers, image optimization with default loader, ISR, dynamic routes without generateStaticParams, cookies, draft mode, middleware, server actions, proxy. GET-only route handlers render static files. next export command removed in v14; dynamic pages must define generateStaticParams or build fails.
